items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Zach Williams; the interviewer identifies him as 'Big Zach' and notes his recent death, but the interviewee's response focuses on Poissy Wright and does not confirm a personal relationship with Williams.

ctx.x: The Dreamland right around the corner. Big store called Billings, Dreamland. We played, packed like sardines. We played, played. Money come on a Saturday night, they raid the place. They put everybody in jail, but they look at the band. They want to put us in jail, but the champions say, oh no, we didn't party. They didn't lock you up that time then? No. All right. Well, that was really bad, didn't they? That was going out of the field then. Going out of the field. All right. Well, got in the field. Well, they…

He just died about a month ago, Ed Garland told us. Poissy Wright died? Wasn't it? Wasn't he the one? I don't know where he is. No, that was the bouncer. The bouncer died. Who was the big chaper? Oh, you're talking about Zach Williams. Zach Williams died about a month ago.

Flo Walker. Big Zach. Yeah. He used to be a, used to wake and move it, yeah. He bought my memories up together now. Well, all right. Poissy, what are you doing coming out the depot? I said, I'm just coming over and looking at the race. He says, well, what's the trouble? I said, well, I'll show him a telegram. He said, oh, I'm sorry. I live on San Pedro Street. He said, I'll tell you what I'm doing. I'm going, we're going to make a trip all the way to El Paso tonight at 1130. And when you get over there, I connect…
